paragraphs: Mesharshiya bar Pekod, one of the Saboraic sages, is mentioned in Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon, part 3, chapter 4.[^1][^2]

notes.text: אגרת דרש״ג is read contextually as Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon, with ח״ג פ״ד as part 3 chapter 4. This is an interpreted work acronym/structure, not a fresh verified edition or a personal title supplied to Mesharshiya. Machine ררש״נ / פ״ר differs from the frozen transcription. Saboraic sages is the collective רבנן סבוראי; bar Pekod alone does not settle a father/place relation or canonical identity.

Hyman supplies place-name Pekod with Jeremiah chapters 50–51. The preserved earlier note reports Miqra according to the Masorah at Jeremiah 50:21 containing Pekod; this turn did not freshly check that witness. The source’s wider chapter range remains unchanged.
